workflow_steps.title: Align second elevation surface to reference grid
workflow_steps.purpose: Create a compatible raster grid for comparison of the two elevation surfaces.
workflow_steps.instructions: Resample input_2 onto the grid of input_1, using input_1 as the reference grid and a 30 metre target resolution. Preserve the elevation values and produce a GeoTIFF raster.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate mean absolute elevation difference
workflow_steps.purpose: Calculate the mean absolute cell-by-cell elevation difference between the two aligned elevation surfaces.
workflow_steps.instructions: Using input_1 and aligned_input_2, calculate the absolute elevation difference for corresponding cells and aggregate those absolute differences to obtain the mean absolute elevation difference. Produce the result as a GeoTIFF raster artifact.
